name: motion-heartbeat
title: Heartbeat
description: Biểu tượng tim (hoặc nút) đập hai nhịp liền như tim thật: nhịp mạnh phồng 1.2, nhịp nhẹ 1.1, rồi nghỉ, lặp lại.

moworks.author: moworks

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Loop 1.4 s: at 0.15 s scale 1 → 1.20 in 80 ms (power1.out) and back to 1 in 220 ms (power2.inOut); at 0.45 s 1 → 1.10 in 80 ms and back in 220 ms; rest until 1.4 s (about 650 ms). For a heart, an icon or a CTA. Params: period (1.4 s) · beats ([0.15, 0.45] s) · amp ([1.2, 1.1]) · rise (0.08 s) · fall (0.22 s).
